observations: A truck-mounted water-borehole drilling rig: white cab-over truck chassis with an orange/rust-colored drill mast and tower structure mounted behind the cab.
A red cylindrical tank (likely a mud/water tank or compressor) is attached low on the left side of the rig.
Visible surface rust and oxidation on the mast and tower framework in all three photos.
Truck tires appear worn, vehicle is parked on bare red earth at what looks like a work yard or roadside lot.
A badge reading 'ND' is visible on the truck grille in photo 1, suggesting the chassis may be a Nissan Diesel/UD Trucks cab, but this is not confirmed as fully legible.
Number plate is partially visible in photo 1 but not clearly readable.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'LOVE PAUL' overlay all three images; no other identifying plates, model tags, or hour-meter are visible on the drilling rig itself.
No photos show the engine, hydraulic pump, winch, rotary head close-up, drill bits, or any operation/running footage.

proof_requests: Video of the rig mast raising/lowering and rotary head turning under power
Video of the truck engine starting and running, plus a short drive
Close-up photos of chassis VIN plate, engine, and registration/ownership documents
Close-up photos of mast welds and frame joints to assess rust/structural integrity
Inventory and photos of drill rods, bits, and auxiliary tooling included
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig by type, but the seller's 'working fine' claim is unverifiable from static photos showing visible rust and no operational evidence, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-functional/high-risk unit pending proof.
